skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental physics concepts and apply them to environmental issues.
Analyze environmental impacts from a physical perspective and propose solutions.
Conduct research, gather data, and present findings on environmental issues.
Identify and solve environmental problems using physical principles.
Work effectively in teams to address environmental challenges.
Effectively communicate environmental issues and solutions.
Evaluate environmental issues critically and propose sustainable solutions.
Understand the importance of environmental protection and promote awareness.
Understand and analyze renewable energy sources and their impact on sustainability.
Understand radiation principles and assess radiation safety issues.
Analyze sound waves and environmental noise issues.
Understand and analyze the impact of electromagnetic waves on the environment.
Analyze climate change factors and propose mitigation strategies.
